pfd_alponte26.t: Financial Disclosure Report, Candidate Report 2026, Monica Maria Alponte (filed 2026-05-28) — Clerk of the U.S. House

checks.legal: News search 2026-10-14 ('Monica Alponte' Libertarian Arizona): results were voter guides only; no court case or legal matter found. She did not answer iVoterGuide's felony/misconduct questions. CourtListener/Justia unreachable.
checks.foreign: 2026 House candidate report read directly: no foreign income; holds preferred shares of three foreign-domiciled shipping companies through a U.S. brokerage account. FARA: exact-name check of the bulk FARA files (registrants, short forms, foreign principals), searched 2026-10-13: no match.
checks.democracy: Never in Congress. News search and her iVoterGuide profile (2026-10-14): no statement on the 2020 or 2024 results found; she left the voter-ID question unanswered.

networth.note: Sum of nine asset ranges on her 2026 candidate report (period Jan 1, 2025–Apr 15, 2026); no liabilities disclosed.

trades.note: Candidate report; no transaction schedule. Never on a congressional committee.

note.t: 2026 candidate report: one personal Fidelity brokerage account holding Apple ($500K–$1M), Chevron ($100K–$250K), Energy Transfer LP units ($100K–$250K), Bank of America 7% preferred ($100K–$250K), Annaly Capital ($50K–$100K), and preferred shares of three foreign-domiciled shipping companies (Costamare, GasLog Partners, Tsakos Energy Navigation; together about $66K–$165K), plus a small Noodles & Co. stake. Income is dividends only; no earned income, positions, agreements or liabilities were reported. This matches her self-described occupation, 'Stock Investor.'

research_notes: iVoterGuide lists an endorsement from Anti-Zionist America PAC (AZAPAC); no contribution from it was checked, so money_flags is unchanged. She signed the U.S. Term Limits pledge (Apr 29, 2026).
